Cai Valdez started making soap as a way to cope with her PTSD. A year and a half later, the former schoolteacher and army vet is on track to make $175,000 — more than double her previous salary.

What started as a side hustle became a full-time job for Cai Valdez, an army vet who started making soap as a way to cope with PTSD. Now, Valdez is on track to make $175,000 a year – more than double her salary as a high school teacher.
